desc:
You are locked in a room with a suspect who refuses to talk. You have 10 tries to get a full confession out of them. Every word matters.

HOW TO PLAY:
💬 Type: Enter your questions into the terminal.
⏳ 10 Tries: If you fail to get a confession, they walk free.
🛑 Be Smart: If you are too mean, they shut down. If you are too nice, they lie.

FEATURES:
🤖 Smart AI responses.
📂 10 Unique Base Cases.
🏆 Daily Cases: A brand new case every single day.

👍 Enjoying the game? Please leave a LIKE and FAVORITE! It helps support my work as a solo dev and keeps the updates coming!
